findings.methylLocus: The large left inset has separated left and right teal backbone rails. Blue C and green G lie between them. Purple CH3 has one short bond ending on C; the bond lies inside the ladder and does not cross or end on either backbone.
findings.locator: The lower left main-DNA segment contains the same blue C and green G with the purple modification on C. The magnification leader selects that marked base-level detail rather than a broad rail. The large inset carries the necessary legible C/G/CH3 information; the small main locator is a correspondence cue.
findings.histone: The large right inset retains a yellow Ac group on the orange histone tail emerging from the orange central protein body.
findings.sequence: Central A-T pairs retain their original letters and pairing; C remains labelled C and paired with G. No mutation, on/off rule, offspring or organism-generation inheritance is depicted.
findings.format: Native PNG 1672 by 941 pixels, approximately 16:9. The main DNA/protein distinction, separate modifications and the large inset lettering remain clear at 360 and 680 pixels. No fine atomic diagram or tiny compulsory caption is introduced.
findings.style: Friendly abstract comic, ivory background, rounded forms, navy outlines and original teal/orange palette are retained. No photorealistic or sterile technical redesign.
findings.actorPerspective: No person, notebook, directional instrument or board is depicted; no actor-view orientation reversal arises.
findings.precisionBoundary: This is a substrate/base-level schematic, not an atom-resolved structure. It identifies cytosine as the modified base without purporting to draw individual ring-carbon valences.
